title: 88Vape Any Tank Raspberry Ripple
description: Raspberry Ripple from 88Vape is a sublimely nostalgic flavour that conjures the taste of a timeless raspberry ripple ice cream in all its sweet, smooth, creamy and summer glory! This e-liquid from 88Vape offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing delicious flavour, smooth throat yet tactile throat hit and satisfying clouds. They have helped countless smokers make the switch to the far safer alternative of vaping with the help of delicious e-liquids at budget-friendly prices. Their 50/50 e-liquids are suitable for most kinds of vape devices, so users can enjoy their favourite flavours with the minimum of fuss. Please note: that the 6mg nicotine strength contains 50VG/50PG while 11mg nicotine strengths contain 30VG/70PG.
